events.title: 충청남도 덕산에서 태어나다
events.description: 충청남도 덕산(오늘날 예산군)에서 태어났다. 아명은 우의, 호는 매헌이다.
events.description_en: He was born in Deoksan, present-day Yesan County in South Chungcheong Province. His childhood name was Uui and his pen name was Maeheon.

events.title: 보통학교를 자퇴하다
events.description: 덕산보통학교에 들어갔으나 이듬해 삼일운동이 일어나자 그 자극을 받아 학교를 그만두었다.
events.description_en: He entered Deoksan Common School, but withdrew the following year after being stirred by the March First Movement.

events.title: 야학을 열고 농민독본을 짓다
events.title_en: He opened a night school and wrote a farmers' primer
events.description: 고향 마을에 야학을 열어 한글과 역사, 산술, 농사 지식을 가르쳤다. 그 교재로 농민독본을 직접 지었다.
events.description_en: He opened a night school in his home village, teaching Hangul, history, arithmetic, and farming knowledge. He wrote a primer for farmers, A Farmer's Reader, to use as its textbook.

events.title: 월진회를 세우고 회장을 맡다
events.title_en: He founded the Woljinhoe and became its head
events.description: 농촌 계몽을 이어갈 조직으로 월진회를 세우고 회장으로 추대되었다.
events.description_en: He founded the Woljinhoe, an organization to carry on rural enlightenment work, and was chosen as its head.

events.title: 만주로 건너가 독립군 기지를 살피다
events.title_en: He crossed into Manchuria to inspect independence army bases
events.description: 고향을 떠나 만주로 건너가 여러 독립군 기지를 둘러보았다.
events.description_en: He left his hometown and crossed into Manchuria, touring several bases of the Korean independence armies.

events.title: 상하이에서 한인애국단에 가입하다
events.title_en: He joined the Korean Patriotic Corps in Shanghai
events.description: 상하이로 건너가 김구가 이끄는 한인애국단에 들어갔다.
events.description_en: He traveled to Shanghai and joined the Korean Patriotic Corps led by Kim Gu.

events.title: 훙커우 공원에서 폭탄을 던지다
events.title_en: He threw a bomb at Hongkou Park
events.description: 상하이사변 전승 기념식이 열린 훙커우 공원에서 단상을 향해 폭탄을 던졌다. 일본군 총사령관을 비롯한 여러 지휘관이 죽거나 다쳤다.
events.description_en: At a ceremony marking Japan's victory in the Shanghai Incident, held in Hongkou Park, he threw a bomb at the reviewing stand. Japan's commanding general and several other officers were killed or wounded.

events.title: 군법회의에서 사형을 선고받다
events.title_en: He was sentenced to death by a military tribunal
events.description: 일본군 상하이파견군 군법회의에서 살인과 폭발물 단속법 위반 혐의로 사형을 선고받았다.
events.description_en: He was sentenced to death by a military tribunal of the Japanese Shanghai Expeditionary Army, on charges of murder and violating explosives control law.

events.title: 가나자와에서 총살당하다
events.title_en: He was executed by firing squad in Kanazawa
events.description: 오사카 형무소를 거쳐 가나자와의 일본군 작업장으로 옮겨져 총살당했다. 스물넷이었다.
events.description_en: He was transferred from an Osaka prison to a Japanese army site in Kanazawa, where he was executed by firing squad. He was twenty-four.
